dedupe_keys.name: bathymetry free reservoir capacity curves and regionalisation across 743 peruvian dams data and code

description: This archive supports a study showing that a reservoir's stage-area-volume curve can be rebuilt from satellite data alone, with Sentinel-1 water extent and SWOT water-surface elevation, and used to audit operators' volume tables without bathymetry. It contains stage-area curves and capacity equations for 18 reservoirs, per-reservoir estimates and thresholds, a regionalisation predicting where the method works, and the 743-dam national inventory of Peru georeferenced, classified and checked against the National Water Authority's map service, plus the 35 Python scripts of the processing chain. Researchers from Peru's National Water Authority, SENAMHI and universities in Lima and Toulouse published it on Zenodo in September 2026 as a free download of about 2 MB under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is national for the inventory and 18 to 44 reservoirs for the curves and validation. Caveats: the companion article was still in preparation, and the method fails for some reservoir types that the regionalisation identifies. Simulation uses: storage curves and dam locations for reservoir network models, capacity planning and drought adaptation in Peru. Related records: the Reservoir Assessment Tool (model-rat-reservoir-assessment-tool) and GeoDAR (data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs).
